title: Going Native 2012 Keynote Stroustrup
summary: Bjarne Stroustrup's keynote at Going Native 2012 covers the ideas behind C++11, including using types to prevent errors and simplifying code with the STL.
why: Cited as a good talk on the thinking behind C++11 and on using the type system to prevent bugs; some other mentions quote it critically.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Very good talk about the ideas behind C++ 11
